final: SELECT s.transref, t.ordertypedist, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_optvolrt, AVG(s.shortintrt) / NULLIF(g.avg_shortintrt, 0) AS ratio FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON t.transreg = s.transref JOIN (SELECT t2.ordertypedist, AVG(s2.shortintrt) AS avg_shortintrt FROM sentimentandfundamentals AS s2 JOIN transactionrecord AS t2 ON t2.transreg = s2.transref GROUP BY t2.ordertypedist) AS g ON t.ordertypedist = g.ordertypedist GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist ORDER BY ratio DESC LIMIT 10
